english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person’s ability to recover from setbacks or withstand severe pressure.

examples.english: Facing setback after setback, they gradually got back on their feet through resilience.
examples.traditional: 面對接二連三嘅挫折，佢靠住抗逆力慢慢振作返。
